regions.merged_text: Deus Dominator -- Princeps pacis -- His slave of necessity - love or justice. What privilege! Fr. Barrolorme Dec. 1300 son of rich man who planned and planmed to have him wed at 24 he flees the world & its danger. Becomes lay-brother- Priest - Serves 20 yrs. poor lepers; At Mass his hand pain fearfully. Next day they are black with leprosy. He goes to Altar and sings "Te Deum"
